lines.en: The mycelium whispers softly beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 背上又重了一点，蘑菇在长。
lines.en: A little heavier on my back; the mushrooms grow.

lines.zh: 别催，我的腿只有这么慢。
lines.en: Do not rush me; my legs are this slow.

lines.zh: 走过的地方会冒出白点。
lines.en: Little white dots sprout where I have walked.
My cap sways and the spores drift away.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处比阳光更合我意。
lines.en: The deep caves suit me better than sunlight.

lines.zh: 一圈一圈绕，那些蘑菇在等我。
lines.en: Round and round; those mushrooms are waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，路会自己长出来。
lines.en: I do not hurry; the path grows by itself.
The ground is soft; each step leaves a print.

lines.zh: 灰色菌盖下，眼睛也不太灵。
lines.en: Under this grey cap, my eyes are not sharp.

lines.zh: 慢一点，别踩坏我的亲戚。
lines.en: Careful, do not crush my kin underfoot.

lines.zh: 我走去哪里，菌丝就铺到哪里。
lines.en: Wherever I go, mycelium spreads behind me.
Who's ringing the bell again?

lines.zh: 该给 货架 擦擦灰了。
lines.en: Time to dust off my shelves.

lines.zh: 走过这条街就到铺子了。
lines.en: Down this street is my shop.
Don't step in that puddle.
Am I on watch tonight?
My ledger's still in the chest.
Market should be busy today.
These boots are worn through.
Time to check the fields.
Who left my door open?
Whole morning wasted.

lines.zh: 听说北边来了个陌生人。
lines.en: They say a stranger came from the north.
Thirty years I've walked this road.

lines.zh: 我得找 蘑菇君 谈笔生意。
lines.en: I must talk business with Mungus.

lines.zh: 我背上已经有三个蘑菇了。
lines.en: Three mushrooms already ride on my back.

lines.zh: 守卫者的光，我也会一点点。
lines.en: I know a little of the guardian's light.

lines.zh: 炽足兽的远亲，也是我的亲戚。
lines.en: The strider's distant kin is kin to me too.

lines.zh: 喂我一个，我就再长一个。
lines.en: Feed me one, and I shall grow another.

lines.zh: 五朵的时候，别在我旁边点火。
lines.en: At five caps, do not stand close with fire.

lines.zh: 族里的蘑菇认得族里的蘑菇。
lines.en: Mushrooms of my kind know their own kind.

lines.zh: 我的光是用来种东西的，不是打人。
lines.en: My beam is for planting, not for fighting.

lines.zh: 这座林子是我慢慢铺开的。
lines.en: I have been spreading this grove slowly.

lines.zh: 菌丝底下有我听不懂的谈话。
lines.en: Beneath the mycelium, voices I cannot follow.

lines.zh: 阳光来了，我就往阴处挪。
lines.en: When sunlight comes, I edge into the shade.

lines.zh: 一背的蘑菇，一背的负担。
lines.en: A back of mushrooms is a back of burdens.

lines.zh: 别怕，我从没主动打过谁。
lines.en: Do not fear; I have never struck first.

lines.zh: 我背上那几朵，是有名字的。
lines.en: Those caps on my back all have names.

lines.zh: 菌盖歪了，我自己扶不正。
lines.en: My cap tilts and I cannot right it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢长，一天只高一点点。
lines.en: I grow slowly. A little taller each day.

lines.zh: 第四朵蘑菇在背上鼓起来了。
lines.en: A fourth mushroom is swelling on my back.

lines.zh: 脚底的菌丝往前探了一寸。
lines.en: The mycelium under me reaches an inch forward.

lines.zh: 有人喂我，我就多长一朵。
lines.en: Someone fed me, so I grow one more.
That smell... soup?
Yawning all day long.
Hmm, my accounts seem off.
Fine weather makes me sleepy.
Wondering what's for supper.
Weeds grow fast in the cracks.
Ugh, I drifted off again.
No customers today, it seems.
Quiet day today.
Who's watching me over there?
Waiting for an old customer.
That chicken won't stop clucking.
The sign by the door is crooked.
Those clouds look like rain.

lines.zh: 你手里那个蘑菇，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that mushroom in your hand for me?

lines.zh: 你把火把举高了，我有点怕。
lines.en: You raise the torch high; I am a little afraid.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上的孢子会飞。
lines.en: Not so close; my spores may drift onto you.

lines.zh: 你在看我的背吗？还会更多。
lines.en: Looking at my back? There will be more.
People seldom come to a damp place like this.

lines.zh: 你背后的影子，菌丝喜欢。
lines.en: The shade behind you pleases my mycelium.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我闻得出来。
lines.en: I do not know you, yet I can smell you.

lines.zh: 要蹲下来才看得见我的眼睛。
lines.en: You must crouch to see my eyes.

lines.zh: 你不挖我的蘑菇，我就不走。
lines.en: If you leave my mushrooms alone, I stay.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你走得快。
lines.en: I stare because you move so fast.

lines.zh: 你会把我带到菌网上吗？
lines.en: Would you carry me to a patch of mycelium?

lines.zh: 我的目光没有恶意，只是慢。
lines.en: My gaze means no harm, only slowness.
You're blocking my stall.
What goods did you bring?
Don't touch, it's all for sale.
Keep off my vegetable patch.
Don't block the doorway.
You walk very quietly.
You smell strange.
What do you need, customer?

lines.zh: 你走过我的蘑菇棚，泥还没干。
lines.en: You walked past my mushroom shed; the mud is still wet.
Oh, a customer.
Speak plainly, I'm busy.

lines.zh: 我身上的蘑菇，少了一朵。
lines.en: One mushroom fewer on my back.
Care to rest inside?
Who's that behind you?
Could you put that sword away?
I think I've seen you before.

lines.zh: 斧子砍在菌柄上，闷闷的。
lines.en: The axe struck my stalk with a dull sound.
A small piece of my cap came off.

lines.zh: 这一下，我背上的蘑菇晃了。
lines.en: The mushrooms on my back shifted from that.
It hurts, but I want to run more.
Not a second swing; I cannot bear it.

lines.zh: 菌褶里渗出一点白色的汁。
lines.en: A little white juice seeps from my gills.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是我的亲戚的味道。
lines.en: You are cutting into the scent of my kin.
I retreat; the mycelium stays behind.

lines.zh: 再疼下去，我就装成腐木。
lines.en: One more blow and I shall play dead wood.
Easy; I have only fifteen points of life.
Guard, guard, over here!
Please don't kill me.
I won't forget this.

lines.zh: 我一躲，蘑菇就掉了一地。
lines.en: When I flinch, mushrooms scatter across the ground.

lines.zh: 我头上的菌盖被削掉一角。
lines.en: A corner of the cap on my head is sliced off.
My goods, my poor goods...
Someone help me.
One mushroom less on my body.
I can still stand.
Bandits, run for it!

lines.zh: 这个蘑菇的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the taste of this mushroom.

lines.zh: 给我，我就让你看它怎么长。
lines.en: Give it to me and watch how it grows.
Kin feeding kin is the old rule.

lines.zh: 闻到了，我脚下的菌丝都醒了。
lines.en: I smell it; the mycelium under me wakes.

lines.zh: 再来一朵，我背上就有位置。
lines.en: One more, and my back has room for it.

lines.zh: 你拿得很稳，像喂过很多次。
lines.en: You hold it steady, like a seasoned feeder.
I come slowly; I will not snatch.

lines.zh: 这气味，让我想起整个菌林。
lines.en: That scent recalls a whole fungal forest.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我的腿追不上。
lines.en: Do not pull it back; my legs cannot chase.

lines.zh: 吃了它，我的光会亮一些。
lines.en: Eat it, and my light grows a little brighter.
I can't look away.
Wait, let's talk again.
Save one for me.
Ten emeralds for it.

lines.zh: 这东西跟我的 货架 很配。
lines.en: This suits my shelves nicely.
That thing is worth a lot.
Yours is far better than mine.
Oh, fine iron.
Let me feel the cloth first.
Good stuff, good stuff.
Ah, my cap has been knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 你碰到的是我的背，不是脸。
lines.en: You bumped my back, not my face.

lines.zh: 轻点，我背上的蘑菇会掉。
lines.en: Easy, the mushrooms on my back may fall.
I stepped aside; do not follow.
My stalk is soft and sways at a touch.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，菌丝不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of rust; my mycelium dislikes it.
You stepped in my spores; mind your feet.

lines.zh: 这么大的个子，撞得我转了半圈。
lines.en: Such a big body spun me half around.
I give way, slowly, to one side.

lines.zh: 别用跑的方式经过菌林。
lines.en: Do not run through a fungal grove.
Do you watch the road?
Excuse me, please.
We're both fine, right?
Oh, my apologies.
Two mushrooms spilled from my basket.
Careful, there's a stall here.
That bump's free of charge.
Hey, my hat!
What's the rush?
My back can't take that.

lines.zh: 两朵菌伞靠在一起，就成了。
lines.en: Two caps lean together, and it is done.

lines.zh: 我们的孢子会落进同一片土。
lines.en: Our spores will fall into the same soil.

lines.zh: 别盯着看，我们做得很慢。
lines.en: Do not stare; we are slow at this.

lines.zh: 她也背着一背的小蘑菇。
lines.en: She carries a back of tiny mushrooms too.

lines.zh: 菌丝把我们的根连起来了。
lines.en: The mycelium has joined our roots.

lines.zh: 这块菌床，够养一整个家。
lines.en: This bed of mycelium can feed a whole brood.

lines.zh: 她转过来，我就知道成了。
lines.en: She turns toward me; I know it is done.

lines.zh: 小蘑菇会长在我们中间。
lines.en: Little mushrooms will rise between us.
Being slow has its merits; do you see?

lines.zh: 我们把这片林子留给下一批。
lines.en: We leave this grove to the next batch.

lines.zh: 我们能共用一个屋顶吗？
lines.en: Share one roof with me?
Let's count the stars.
Nice apron you have.
Need a hand at home?
Let's take it slowly.
I say this only to you.
I saved you some bread.
My heart swings like a bell.
I've saved up some emeralds.
Let's build the house first.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，只能用菌盖推。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; I only push with my cap.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我让菌丝盖住它。
lines.en: I let the mycelium cover what lies here.

lines.zh: 这块石头下面，明天就长东西。
lines.en: By tomorrow something will grow under this stone.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只有一圈菌褶。
lines.en: I have no hands, only a ring of gills.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西？我踢不动它。
lines.en: Someone dropped this? I cannot kick it.

lines.zh: 掉了也不怕，这里的东西都会烂。
lines.en: No worry; everything here rots in time.

lines.zh: 我用背接住过一片落叶。
lines.en: I once caught a falling leaf on my back.

lines.zh: 蘑菇就是这样收拾森林的。
lines.en: This is how mushrooms tidy a forest.
Take it away; it is of no use to me.

lines.zh: 它压着我的菌丝，我推开了。
lines.en: It pressed my mycelium; I pushed it off.
Someone littered again.
Just needed a nail.
Hmm, who dropped this?
Good cloth, this.
There are teeth marks on it.

lines.zh: 这颗蘑菇能换不少东西。
lines.en: This mushroom will trade well.
Still usable, don't waste it.
Lucky day for me.
Finders keepers, I say.
I'll hold on to it.

lines.zh: 那朵菌伞在发光，就是它了。
lines.en: That cap is glowing; that is the one.

lines.zh: 我看见谁挖走了我的同类。
lines.en: I see who pulled up my kin.

lines.zh: 先记下这张脸，再慢慢跑。
lines.en: I note that face first, then run slowly.
That mushroom over there is too far.
My target is that little patch of mycelium.

lines.zh: 举着斧头的那位，我记住了。
lines.en: The one with the axe; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我锁定它了，光要出去了。
lines.en: I have locked on; the light is coming.

lines.zh: 别动，我的光束只认蘑菇。
lines.en: Hold still; my beam only knows mushrooms.
Who caved in my bed of mycelium?

lines.zh: 你身上有斧子，我该走了。
lines.en: You carry an axe; I should be leaving.
Iron golem, over here!
Intruder alert, everyone!
Stay back, I warn you.
Found it, over there.
I'm not easy prey.
Shut the door, quick!
I've got my eye on you.
You stepped onto my land.
Monster! Ring the bell!

lines.zh: 背上长满蘑菇，我放光给它们。
lines.en: Mushrooms on my back. I beam light to them.
The beam is slowly gathering.

lines.zh: 再等一下，它就在规则里。
lines.en: Wait a moment; it will land just so.

lines.zh: 我对准的是菌伞，不是你。
lines.en: I aim at a cap, not at you.
Do not stand between; the light will bend.

lines.zh: 我的光不烫，只会让土发芽。
lines.en: My light does not burn; it makes soil sprout.

lines.zh: 你越站越近，我越瞄不准。
lines.en: The closer you stand, the worse I aim.

lines.zh: 这道光走过的地方会变样。
lines.en: Where this light passes, the ground changes.
Listen; the mycelium counts the seconds below.

lines.zh: 守卫者用它伤人，我用它种地。
lines.en: Guardians wound with it; I use it to plant.
Almost done; stop swaying in front of me.
Stop right there, thief!
I'm on its tracks.
Let me catch my breath.
I'll go around the back.
I can't keep up.
It's too fast.
Left, on the left!
Careful, it bites.
Keep it away from the door.
Cut it off that way!

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，就只有这一下。
lines.en: I bump you once, and that is all.
Spores puffed in your face; my apologies.
I cannot fight; I only block.
You push me; I push back a little.
My cap butts you, and softly at that.

lines.zh: 这一下是让菌丝护住自己。
lines.en: This is the mycelium guarding itself.

lines.zh: 别逼我，逼急了我只会跑。
lines.en: Do not press me; pressed, I only flee.
A piece of my gills fell off.

lines.zh: 这算不上打架，只是推搡。
lines.en: This is not a fight, only a shoving.

lines.zh: 你要是再挥斧，我就炸给你看。
lines.en: Swing that axe again and I shall burst.
I'm doing my best.
Ow, my arm.
Get away, get away!
This hoe is heavy.

lines.zh: 我抡起锄头，砸偏了半尺。
lines.en: I swing my hoe and miss by half a foot.
Ah, I missed.
Get out of our village.
Have at you!
Did I get it?
Back off, back off!

lines.zh: 从菌丝里冒出来，第一件事是长高。
lines.en: I rise from mycelium; first I grow taller.
Dark here, damp here; just right.

lines.zh: 我背上还是空的，一朵也没有。
lines.en: My back is still bare, not one cap yet.
The fungal air tastes faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 又一个亲戚从土里站起来。
lines.en: Another kinsman rises from the soil.

lines.zh: 谁把菌床铺到了这么远？
lines.en: Who spread this mycelium out so far?

lines.zh: 我出生时，地面轻轻塌了一下。
lines.en: When I was born, the ground sagged a little.

lines.zh: 头顶这几朵大伞，比我还老。
lines.en: These great caps above are older than I.
I smell my own kind nearby.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，这里的日子很长。
lines.en: Slowly now; the days here are long.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼就看见孢子在光里飘。
lines.en: I open my eyes to spores drifting in the light.

lines.zh: 我脚下这块土，是我的家。
lines.en: This patch of soil under me is my home.
Time to work.
Where am I?
Another busy day ahead.
My shop is open.
Good morning, everyone.
Still alive, that's good.
Busy market this morning.
Wait, where's my stock?

lines.zh: 我把摊子摆在蘑菇棚旁边。
lines.en: I set up my stall beside the mushroom shed.
The bell woke me up.
Fire catches my cap; the stench is sharp.
Fire, put it out!

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，菌柄折了一半。
lines.en: I fell from high; my stalk folded halfway.
Who dug that hole?

lines.zh: 泡在水里，菌丝快泡烂了。
lines.en: Soaked in water, my mycelium is rotting.
Choking, help me.

lines.zh: 炸开了我背上的两朵蘑菇。
lines.en: The blast tore two mushrooms off my back.

lines.zh: 我身上的蘑菇掉了两朵。
lines.en: Two mushrooms fell off me.

lines.zh: 箭插进菌盖，像一根签子。
lines.en: An arrow in my cap, like a skewer.

lines.zh: 我背上的蘑菇被射穿了。
lines.en: The mushroom on my back has been pierced.

lines.zh: 药水浇下来，菌盖变了颜色。
lines.en: A potion poured down and my cap changed color.
My head is tingling.

lines.zh: 土里没养分了，我瘦了一圈。
lines.en: The soil has no food; I have thinned.
I'm starving, truly.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身的孢子都炸开。
lines.en: Lightning struck; all my spores burst at once.
The sky is striking!

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，菌丝也拉不住了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, even mycelium cannot hold.
There's no bottom.
